status: Open: hardware-specific ranged-attack failure reported; Flycast passes per project owner; cause and fix unconfirmed

report.text: A black screen always occurs during long-range attacks (all), regardless of whether the character is controlled by the player or the CPU. There is no animation whatsoever.
report.trigger: Every long-range attack, as reported by tester
unknowns: Exact build used for the hardware/Flycast comparison
Whether combat returns normally after the invisible sequence
report.interpretation: Investigate missing attack scene/animation first. Damage 77 placement cannot be judged from a missing scene alone. Do not classify this as the old New Game/mission-dialogue entry hang without evidence.

platform_follow_up.text: I checked and it seems it only happen on hardware, on flycast I also don't get this bug
platform_follow_up.interpretation: Treat the failure as hardware-specific based on the report; emulator success does not validate a hardware repair. Exact emulator version, image identity and matched attack sequence were not restated.

local_investigation.current_build_change: Only the two P/W marker coordinate instruction pairs differ from public 0.7.50; no battle-animation fix was included in 0.7.51.
local_investigation.resource_evidence: work/output/dcp-0.7.51-local/original-tree.json and target-tree.json; full DCP round-trip already verified
local_investigation.caveat: EFFECT.AFS contains translated labels and is not byte-identical to the original. Resource integrity does not establish successful runtime loading or rendering.

historical_comparison.scope: Polygon/clip/movie geometry helpers, range/raw-strip/line adapters and clip helper match the captured 0.7.23 executable. Other runtime code differs. Historical split-screen captures are not a current all-ranged-attacks pass.

live.observed: Cold boot, opening video and title screen render.
live.limitation: Automated keys did not reliably reach the game menu; no ranged battle was reproduced. Asked project owner to prepare a battle save in the isolated window. Main emulator profile and VMU were not modified.
live.confirmation: Project owner reports ranged attacks work in Flycast. No agent-observed ranged-battle pass is claimed.
live.preparation_request: Superseded by the hardware-only clarification; owner need not prepare the isolated Flycast window solely to reproduce this failure.

bounded_audit.limitation: Does not exercise an actual attack, live resource allocation or GPU rendering.

hardware_review.finding: The current graphics reservation restores the original 320x240 total while the game runs at 640x480; that builder explicitly leaves physical/full-game geometry headroom unverified. This is a concrete allocation difference to inspect, not a demonstrated cause.
other_checks: Hardware alignment requirements in attack-path memory reads
Cache visibility and transfer completion for graphics uploads
Lifetime of temporary render buffers and interaction with text/cut-in rendering
hardware_review.limitation: No hardware trace or failing-path allocation result yet. Do not change multiple shared rendering paths or claim a fix based on Flycast alone.

next_validation: Use a repeatable player/CPU ranged-attack sequence on the affected hardware and record the exact build/image identity.
Keep Flycast as the passing control; compare against the original Japanese game on the same hardware where available.
Audit the ranged path for concrete alignment, memory-capacity, cache/transfer and buffer-lifetime defects; separate proven defects from hypotheses.
Prepare a narrowly scoped diagnostic only when its changed behavior and expected hardware result are explicit. A Flycast pass alone cannot establish the fix.
Require hardware retests of ranged attacks from both sides, melee, cut-ins/damage, New Game and mission dialogues before declaring the failure fixed.
